Butler National Corporation is an aerospace-focused holding company that delivers engineering, aircraft modifications, electrical systems integration, commercial and defense electronics, and professional management services. Our businesses support commercial operators, defense partners, and original equipment manufacturers.

Our primary operations include Avcon Industries, BNC Tempe, and the professional services segment anchored by the Boot Hill Casino. Together, these businesses combine advanced engineering with reliable service delivery to support long-term growth.
Our Business Segments & Subsidiaries
Butler National Corporation is comprised of 5 key subsidiaries operating across industries such as aerospace, avionics, defense, and professional services.
Avcon provides FAA-approved aircraft modifications, engineering, avionics and electrical systems integration, and special mission solutions.
BNC Tempe supplies commercial and defense electronics, wiring harnesses, and system controls to OEMs and government agencies.
Our professional services segment provides management and operational expertise in gaming and hospitality.

raw_blocks: Butler National Corporation is a public holding company with more than six decades of experience in aerospace engineering, aircraft modifications, avionics integration, special purpose electronics design and manufacturing, and professional gaming management services. Established in 1960 through the merger of an aviation research firm and the National Connector Corporation, Butler National has evolved into an aerospace-led organization serving commercial operators, defense customers, OEM’s, and agencies across the globe.
We emphasize engineering excellence, operational reliability, and long-term value creation for shareholders. Butler National is OTCQX listed under the ticker BUKS.
Butler National oversees subsidiaries that provide:
Aircraft modifications, avionics and electrical systems integration, and special mission solutions
Commercial and defense electronics, wire/cable harness assemblies, and system components
Professional management services for gaming operations
This combination of engineering capability and disciplined operational management supports sustainable growth across our business segments.

Butler National is guided by an experienced leadership team and a Board of Directors committed to strong governance, compliance, and transparency. Our governance framework includes established committees, corporate policies, charters, and a code of ethics that guide responsible conduct across all subsidiaries.
Our operating subsidiaries focus on aerospace engineering and modifications, commercial electronics, and professional management services.
Avcon provides FAA approved aircraft modifications, engineering, avionics and electrical systems integration, and special mission solutions.
BNC Tempe supplies commercial and defense electronics, wiring harnesses, and system controls to OEMs and government agencies.
Our professional services segment provides management and operational expertise in gaming and hospitality.
Butler National is listed with OTCQX under the symbol BUKS. Shareholders can access financial reports, quarterly results, governance documents, and disclosures in the Investor Relations section.

pages.raw_meta: Operates Avcon Inc. and Butler Avionics, supplies commercial and defense electronics, manages Boot Hill Casino & Resort, and runs KC Machine.
raw_blocks: Butler National Corporation oversees a group of aerospace and professional services subsidiaries that support commercial operators, defense partners, original equipment manufacturers and agencies around the world. Our primary operations focus on aircraft engineering and modifications, avionics integration, and commercial electronics design and manufacturing, with additional services provided through our professional management segment.

Our aerospace subsidiaries deliver engineering, FAA-approved aircraft modifications, avionics integration, commercial electronics, wiring systems, and special mission solutions. These businesses support a broad range of commercial, defense, and government programs.

Avcon provides FAA-approved aircraft modifications, engineering, systems integration and avionics for commercial and defense operators. The team delivers reliable airframe upgrades and mission solutions for a wide range of aircraft.
New Century, KS | Newton, KS

Butler National – Tempe manufactures commercial and defense electronics, wiring and cabling harnesses, and system components for OEMs and government agencies. The team produces both custom assemblies and commercial off-the-shelf solutions.
Explore Butler National – Tempe
Butler Avionics provides avionics sales, installations, upgrades, and repair services, supporting Avcon’s engineering and aircraft modification programs as well as general aviation customers.

Butler Machine is an ITAR registered, ISO certified machine shop providing precision CNC machining, laser marking, and quality inspection services. The team produces high-tolerance components that support aerospace and defense programs.

Our professional services segment provides management and operational support for gaming facilities. Through Butler National Service Corporation (BNSC), we deliver reliable, compliant, and quality-focused management solutions.

Boot Hill Casino and Resort, managed by BHCMC, LLC and BNSC, provides professional management and operational services for state-regulated gaming facilities. The property offers gaming on behalf of the state as well as dining & guest services.
How Our Businesses Work Together
Each subsidiary brings its own expertise while contributing to a coordinated strategy that benefits our customers and supports sustained value for shareholders.
